archetypes.name: summary-marker
archetypes.rationale: Final summary emission now relies on stdout marker boundaries across success and abort paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5c and Final summary marker emission paths. Check that marker pairs are emitted only when a non-empty summary exists, that validator rc 4 does not emit stale markers, and that sidecar path handoff still follows summary output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step5-compat
archetypes.rationale: Legacy design-step5.sh now delegates into the live Step 5b prepare wrapper.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the compatibility wrapper and Step 5b prepare ordering. Verify legacy argv is reconstructed safely, the live SKILL flow no longer calls design-step5.sh, and the step-4b sentinel plus timing mark occur in the intended order relative to pause checks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
